limits: Finite algebra checks shared retained equations and conditional source assertions; not a full PDE/characteristic existence theorem, past-state calculation, physical energy, state-selection law or cosmological-origin evidence.

run_controls.actual_child_protocol: Each case is a real isolated child, exit2, one exact status/reason JSON dictionary, empty stderr, absent new output or preexisting bytes preserved.

runtime: Python3.12.14 standard library only; all child flags -I -S -B with optional -O

verify.output_rule: Fresh file with existing parent outside resolved component and repository; symlink path components rejected; semantic path normalization allowed.
verify.runtime_failure: Listed post-parse failures return exit2, exactly one JSON stdout line, empty stderr, exact reason, no new output or preserved preexisting bytes. Standard argparse usage errors/--help use standard argparse output.
